get.description: Download a report exported by the legacy report store. Current exports return a url on the API2 origin (https://api.webmania.com.br/relatorios/{uuid}); download those with fiscalDownloadReportV2 instead. CSV and XLSX files arrive labeled text/xml, so the format is identified from the bytes.

200.description: Binary file when authorized; a JSON error can also occur at HTTP200. CSV and XLSX arrive labeled text/xml. Preserve bytes, Content-Type and safe download metadata.

schema.description: CSV and XLSX legacy reports are sent labeled text/xml. Identify the format from the bytes: a ZIP local-file signature is XLSX, any other report body is CSV kept byte-exact. An XML document, HTML page or JSON error is never a report.

default.description: HTTP/auth/availability failure; never treat HTML/JSON as the requested fiscal file.

x-auth-origin-policy.capability: The complete returned report URL/UUID authorizes one exported report and is sensitive. Company headers are unnecessary and must not be attached automatically.

x-retry-policy.reason: Report download consumes a bounded quota (by default 5 downloads per 24 hours). Even a GET must not be blindly replayed.

get.x-sdk-transfer-policy: Report files labeled text/xml are CSV or XLSX: XLSX starts with a ZIP local-file signature, any other body is CSV and is returned unchanged. Refuse an XML, HTML or JSON body as a report; a JSON body with error is a failure even at HTTP 200.

DocumentToken.name: token
DocumentToken.description: Encrypted document-scoped capability, valid24hours. Not a company credential. Never log the URL/token.

Uuid.description: Opaque provider document/event UUID; preserve case/content.

AccessKey.description: 44-character fiscal access key. Keep as text. Alphanumeric issuer identifiers are accepted only when enabled by the provider/environment.
